title: On Convergence Analysis of Network-GIANT: An approximate Hessian-based fully distributed optimization algorithm
summary: This paper presents a detailed convergence and performance analysis of a recently developed approximate Newton-type fully distributed optimization method for \(L\)-smooth, \(μ\)-strongly convex local loss functions, called Network-GIANT (inspired by the Federated learning algorithm GIANT possessing mixed linear-quadratic convergence properties).
